from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Print `[level] message` to standard output, followed by a newline.

    The level and message are used verbatim (no case changes or trimming).
    Console output only: this function must not touch the file system.
    """
    print(f"[{level}] {message}")


def test_basic_format(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "hello")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[INFO] hello\n"
    assert captured.err == ""


def test_level_used_verbatim(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("warn", "Disk Almost Full")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[warn] Disk Almost Full\n"


def test_empty_message(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("DEBUG", "")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[DEBUG] \n"


def test_empty_level(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("", "msg")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[] msg\n"


def test_message_whitespace_and_brackets_preserved(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    log_line("E", "  [x]  spaced  ")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[E]   [x]  spaced  \n"


def test_multiple_calls_append_lines(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "one")
    log_line("ERROR", "two")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] one\n[ERROR] two\n"


def test_prints_only_and_nothing_to_stderr(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "x")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[INFO] x\n"
    assert captured.err == ""


def test_does_not_touch_file_system(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)

    def forbidden_open(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        raise AssertionError("log_line must not open files")

    monkeypatch.setattr("builtins.open", forbidden_open)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "open", forbidden_open)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "write_text", forbidden_open)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "write_bytes", forbidden_open)

    log_line("INFO", "console only")

    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] console only\n"
    assert list(tmp_path.iterdir()) == []
